# Lorenz Espinosa — expanded public profile
> Short version: /llms.txt

## Identity and background
Lorenz Leslie Espinosa is an IT systems and automation consultant based in the Philippines. His background includes IT support and systems administration, Microsoft Cloud, Windows Server and AWS. He works on practical integrations and documentation for small teams and larger organizations. Remote work with English-speaking teams is possible; specific engagements depend on fit and scope.

## Services (terms set by scope)
- Workflow review and mapping of systems, ownership and exceptions.
- Scoped integration and automation implementation.
- Ongoing systems support by agreement.
- AI steps where appropriate, with a person responsible for consequential decisions. Scope and terms are agreed before work begins.

Work typically involves existing tools, APIs and webhooks, input validation, error paths, operational documentation and support arrangements. The exact safeguards depend on the project; this is not a blanket security, compliance, runtime or outcome guarantee.

## Public code example
[n8n-lint](https://github.com/lorenzespinosa/n8n-lint) is a JavaScript CLI for static checks on n8n workflow JSON before import. It can flag likely exposed credential strings, structural problems and common mistakes for review. It cannot prove that a workflow will be secure, compliant or successful after deployment. The repository is a code example, not evidence of confidential client systems or results.

Client engagements are confidential. No client names, case studies, screenshots, savings figures or outcome metrics are provided here.
